claim: EBS Block Express is the next generation of EBS storage server architecture, built for the highest performance with sub-millisecond latency; it uses Scalable Reliable Datagrams (SRD) to talk to Nitro System-based EC2 instances.
question: What is EBS Block Express?

values.display: next generation of Amazon EBS storage server architecture

evidence.quote: EBS Block Express is the next generation of Amazon EBS storage server architecture purpose-built to deliver the highest levels of performance with sub-millisecond latency for block storage at cloud scale.
Block Express does this by using Scalable Reliable Datagrams (SRD), a high-performance lower-latency network protocol, to communicate with Nitro System-based EC2 instances.
